<script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/three.js/r128/three.min.js"></script>
<script>
'use strict';
/* =================================================================
   ASTRALIS — front-of-site interactions + galaxy explorer
   ================================================================= */
const $=s=>document.querySelector(s), $$=s=>[...document.querySelectorAll(s)];
const reduceMotion=matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
const state={cart:0,selectedStar:null,reservedStar:null,reserveEnds:0,pkg:'premium',certTheme:'midnight',prices:{standard:39,premium:79,ultimate:139}};

/* ---------- nav scroll ---------- */
const nav=$('#nav');
addEventListener('scroll',()=>{
  nav.classList.toggle('scrolled',scrollY>30);
  $('#stickyCta').classList.toggle('on',scrollY>window.innerHeight*0.6);
},{passive:true});

/* ---------- smooth in-page anchors (works in in-app browsers too) ---------- */
$$('a[href^="#"]').forEach(a=>a.addEventListener('click',e=>{
  if(a.dataset.page)return;            /* handled by sub-page router */
  let t=null;try{t=document.querySelector(a.getAttribute('href'));}catch(_){ }
  if(!t)return;
  e.preventDefault();
  t.scrollIntoView({behavior:reduceMotion?'auto':'smooth',block:'start'});
}));

/* ---------- scroll reveals ---------- */
const io=new IntersectionObserver(es=>es.forEach(e=>{if(e.isIntersecting){e.target.classList.add('in');io.unobserve(e.target);}}),{threshold:.15});
$$('.fx').forEach(el=>io.observe(el));

/* ---------- animated counters ---------- */
const cio=new IntersectionObserver(es=>es.forEach(e=>{
  if(!e.isIntersecting)return;cio.unobserve(e.target);
  const el=e.target,end=+el.dataset.count,dec=el.dataset.decimal,suf=el.dataset.suffix||'';
  const t0=performance.now(),dur=1800;
  (function tick(t){
    const p=Math.min(1,(t-t0)/dur),v=end*(1-Math.pow(1-p,3));
    el.textContent=(dec?(v/10).toFixed(1):Math.round(v).toLocaleString())+suf;
    if(p<1)requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  })(t0);
}),{threshold:.4});
$$('[data-count]').forEach(el=>cio.observe(el));

/* ---------- twinkling starfield (hero + final CTA) ---------- */
function initStarfield(cv){
  if(!cv)return;
  const cx=cv.getContext('2d');
  let W,H,stars=[],shoots=[],mx=0,my=0,raf=0,beat=performance.now();
  function size(){W=cv.width=cv.offsetWidth*devicePixelRatio;H=cv.height=cv.offsetHeight*devicePixelRatio;
    stars=Array.from({length:Math.min(340,W*H/9000)},()=>({x:Math.random()*W,y:Math.random()*H,r:Math.random()*1.4+.3,tw:Math.random()*Math.PI*2,sp:.4+Math.random()*1.2,depth:.3+Math.random()*.7,rot:(Math.random()-.5)*.5,flare:0,flareUp:false}));}
  size();addEventListener('resize',size);addEventListener('load',size);
  /* pre-rendered star sprites: soft core + 4-point diffraction spikes */
  function makeStarSprite(spiked){
    const c=document.createElement('canvas');c.width=c.height=96;const g=c.getContext('2d');
    const grad=g.createRadialGradient(48,48,0,48,48,13);
    grad.addColorStop(0,'rgba(255,255,255,.95)');grad.addColorStop(.45,'rgba(228,236,255,.38)');grad.addColorStop(1,'rgba(228,236,255,0)');
    g.fillStyle=grad;g.beginPath();g.arc(48,48,13,0,7);g.fill();
    if(spiked){
      g.translate(48,48);
      const spike=(L,w,a)=>{
        const lg=(x1,y1,x2,y2)=>{const l=g.createLinearGradient(x1,y1,x2,y2);l.addColorStop(0,'rgba(255,252,242,0)');l.addColorStop(.5,`rgba(255,252,242,${a})`);l.addColorStop(1,'rgba(255,252,242,0)');return l;};
        g.lineWidth=w;
        g.strokeStyle=lg(-L,0,L,0);g.beginPath();g.moveTo(-L,0);g.lineTo(L,0);g.stroke();
        g.strokeStyle=lg(0,-L,0,L);g.beginPath();g.moveTo(0,-L);g.lineTo(0,L);g.stroke();
      };
      spike(45,1.5,.85);          /* long sharp vertical/horizontal rays */
      g.rotate(Math.PI/4);
      spike(20,1,.32);            /* short faint diagonal rays */
    }
    return c;
  }
  const SPR_CORE=makeStarSprite(false),SPR_SPIKE=makeStarSprite(true);
  addEventListener('mousemove',e=>{mx=(e.clientX/innerWidth-.5);my=(e.clientY/innerHeight-.5);},{passive:true});
  let last=0;
  function frame(t){
    raf=requestAnimationFrame(frame);
    beat=t;
    if(reduceMotion&&last)return; last=t;
    cx.clearRect(0,0,W,H);
    for(const s of stars){
      s.tw+=0.015*s.sp;
      /* occasional flare: a star surges bright, then dims back slowly */
      if(s.flare===0){if(Math.random()<0.000015){s.flare=0.01;s.flareUp=true;}}
      else if(s.flareUp){s.flare=Math.min(1,s.flare+0.04);if(s.flare>=1)s.flareUp=false;}
      else{s.flare*=0.99;if(s.flare<0.02)s.flare=0;}
      const pulse=Math.abs(Math.sin(s.tw));
      const a=Math.min(1,.22+.48*pulse+s.flare*.75); /* kept gentle, never blinding */
      const px=s.x+mx*40*s.depth*devicePixelRatio, py=s.y+my*40*s.depth*devicePixelRatio;
      const spiked=s.r>.95||s.flare>.5;
      const k=(s.r*devicePixelRatio*1.5/13)*(.85+.3*pulse)*(1+s.flare*1.1);
      cx.save();cx.globalAlpha=a;cx.translate(px,py);
      if(spiked)cx.rotate(s.rot);
      cx.drawImage(spiked?SPR_SPIKE:SPR_CORE,-48*k,-48*k,96*k,96*k);
      cx.restore();
    }
    /* shooting stars: enter near the top right, streak down to the left */
    if(Math.random()<0.003&&shoots.length<2)shoots.push({x:W*(.55+Math.random()*.45),y:Math.random()*H*.3,vx:-(7+Math.random()*5)*devicePixelRatio,vy:(3+Math.random()*2)*devicePixelRatio,life:1});
    for(let i=shoots.length-1;i>=0;i--){const sh=shoots[i];sh.x+=sh.vx;sh.y+=sh.vy;sh.life-=.018;
      if(sh.life<=0){shoots.splice(i,1);continue;}
      const g=cx.createLinearGradient(sh.x,sh.y,sh.x-sh.vx*9,sh.y-sh.vy*9);
      g.addColorStop(0,`rgba(255,250,235,${sh.life})`);g.addColorStop(1,'rgba(255,250,235,0)');
      cx.strokeStyle=g;cx.lineWidth=1.6*devicePixelRatio;cx.beginPath();cx.moveTo(sh.x,sh.y);cx.lineTo(sh.x-sh.vx*9,sh.y-sh.vy*9);cx.stroke();}
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  /* watchdog: if the rAF chain ever dies (throttling, hiccups), restart it */
  setInterval(()=>{if(!document.hidden&&performance.now()-beat>1500){cancelAnimationFrame(raf);requestAnimationFrame(frame);}},2000);
}
initStarfield($('#starfield'));
initStarfield($('#finalStarfield'));

/* ---------- 3D tilt on certificates ---------- */
$$('.cert').forEach(c=>{
  const stage=c.parentElement;
  stage.addEventListener('mousemove',e=>{
    const r=c.getBoundingClientRect();
    const x=(e.clientX-r.left)/r.width-.5, y=(e.clientY-r.top)/r.height-.5;
    c.style.transform=`rotateY(${x*14}deg) rotateX(${-y*12}deg)`;
  });
  stage.addEventListener('mouseleave',()=>c.style.transform='');
});

function starMapSVG(seed){
  let dots='',lines='';const cp=[];
  for(let i=0;i<48;i++){
    const a=h1(i,seed)*6.283,r=Math.sqrt(h1(i,seed+11))*41;
    const x=50+Math.cos(a)*r,y=50+Math.sin(a)*r;
    if(i<6)cp.push([x,y]);
    dots+='<circle cx="'+x.toFixed(1)+'" cy="'+y.toFixed(1)+'" r="'+(.35+h1(i,seed+22)*.85).toFixed(2)+'" fill="var(--cg2)" opacity="'+(.3+h1(i,seed+33)*.55).toFixed(2)+'"/>';
  }
  for(let i=0;i<cp.length-1;i++)lines+='<line x1="'+cp[i][0].toFixed(1)+'" y1="'+cp[i][1].toFixed(1)+'" x2="'+cp[i+1][0].toFixed(1)+'" y2="'+cp[i+1][1].toFixed(1)+'" stroke="var(--cg)" stroke-width=".25" opacity=".5"/>';
  return '<svg class="ct-mapsvg" viewBox="0 0 100 100">'
    +'<defs><radialGradient id="mg'+seed+'" cx=".5" cy=".42" r=".62"><stop offset="0" stop-color="var(--map1)"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="var(--map2)"/></radialGradient></defs>'
    +'<circle cx="50" cy="50" r="46" fill="url(#mg'+seed+')"/>'
    +'<circle cx="50" cy="50" r="46" fill="none" stroke="var(--cg)" stroke-width=".7"/>'
    +'<circle cx="50" cy="50" r="42.5" fill="none" stroke="var(--cg)" stroke-width=".3" stroke-dasharray="1.5 2.5" opacity=".7"/>'
    +lines+dots
    +'<g stroke="var(--cg2)" stroke-linecap="round">'
    +'<line x1="50" y1="26" x2="50" y2="74" stroke-width=".8"/>'
    +'<line x1="26" y1="50" x2="74" y2="50" stroke-width=".8"/>'
    +'<line x1="37" y1="37" x2="63" y2="63" stroke-width=".45" opacity=".6"/>'
    +'<line x1="63" y1="37" x2="37" y2="63" stroke-width=".45" opacity=".6"/></g>'
    +'<circle cx="50" cy="50" r="7" fill="var(--cg2)" opacity=".25"/>'
    +'<circle cx="50" cy="50" r="2.4" fill="#fff"/></svg>';
}
function certCell(ic,k,cls,v){return '<div class="ct-cell">'+CERT_ICONS[ic]+'<div><div class="k">'+k+'</div><div class="v '+cls+'">'+v+'</div></div></div>';}
function certGalaxyTexture(ivory){
  const c=document.createElement('canvas');c.width=620;c.height=1066;const x=c.getContext('2d');
  const gauss=()=> (Math.random()+Math.random()+Math.random()-1.5)/1.5;
  const g=x.createLinearGradient(0,0,620,1066);
  if(ivory){g.addColorStop(0,'#F7F2E7');g.addColorStop(.5,'#F3EDDF');g.addColorStop(1,'#ECE4D0');}
  else{g.addColorStop(0,'#0D1228');g.addColorStop(.55,'#080C1C');g.addColorStop(1,'#0A0E22');}
  x.fillStyle=g;x.fillRect(0,0,620,1066);
  /* nebula corner glows */
  const blobs=ivory?[[90,140,280,'rgba(168,140,228,.20)'],[500,90,230,'rgba(228,192,120,.22)'],[560,980,250,'rgba(160,135,220,.13)']]
                   :[[95,160,290,'rgba(140,110,220,.17)'],[520,95,210,'rgba(217,170,110,.11)'],[545,985,250,'rgba(120,95,210,.11)']];
  blobs.forEach(b=>{const rg=x.createRadialGradient(b[0],b[1],0,b[0],b[1],b[2]);rg.addColorStop(0,b[3]);rg.addColorStop(1,'rgba(0,0,0,0)');x.fillStyle=rg;x.fillRect(0,0,620,1066);});
  /* milky-way diagonal band up the left side */
  const sc=ivory?'232,182,110':'255,222,172';
  for(let i=0;i<26;i++){const t=Math.random(),bx=35+t*250+gauss()*45,by=660-t*600+gauss()*55;
    const rg=x.createRadialGradient(bx,by,0,bx,by,55+Math.random()*55);
    rg.addColorStop(0,ivory?'rgba(195,165,228,.11)':'rgba(190,170,230,.09)');rg.addColorStop(1,'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
    x.fillStyle=rg;x.fillRect(0,0,620,1066);}
  for(let i=0;i<1200;i++){
    const t=Math.random(),bx=35+t*250+gauss()*58*(1-t*.3),by=660-t*600+gauss()*75;
    const r=Math.random()<.92?Math.random()*1.1+.3:Math.random()*2+1.3;
    x.fillStyle='rgba('+sc+','+((ivory?.7:1)*(.22+Math.random()*.55)).toFixed(2)+')';
    x.beginPath();x.arc(bx,by,r,0,7);x.fill();
    if(r>1.5){const rg=x.createRadialGradient(bx,by,0,bx,by,r*4);
      rg.addColorStop(0,'rgba('+sc+',.45)');rg.addColorStop(1,'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
      x.fillStyle=rg;x.beginPath();x.arc(bx,by,r*4,0,7);x.fill();}
  }
  /* scattered field stars across the whole sheet */
  const fc=ivory?'190,160,105':'236,240,255';
  for(let i=0;i<460;i++){
    x.fillStyle='rgba('+fc+','+((ivory?.55:1)*(.14+Math.random()*.5)).toFixed(2)+')';
    x.beginPath();x.arc(Math.random()*620,Math.random()*1066,Math.random()*1.1+.25,0,7);x.fill();
  }
  /* a few bright 4-point sparkles */
  for(let i=0;i<15;i++){
    const sx=Math.random()*620,sy=Math.random()*1066,L=4+Math.random()*9;
    x.strokeStyle='rgba('+sc+','+(ivory?.5:.7)+')';x.lineWidth=.9;
    x.beginPath();x.moveTo(sx-L,sy);x.lineTo(sx+L,sy);x.moveTo(sx,sy-L);x.lineTo(sx,sy+L);x.stroke();
    const rg=x.createRadialGradient(sx,sy,0,sx,sy,L);rg.addColorStop(0,'rgba('+sc+',.75)');rg.addColorStop(1,'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
    x.fillStyle=rg;x.beginPath();x.arc(sx,sy,L,0,7);x.fill();
  }
  return c.toDataURL('image/png');
}

const SPECTRAL=['O5 V','B3 V','A1 V','A7 V','F2 V','F8 V','G2 V','G8 V','K1 III','K5 V','M0 V','M4 III'];
const SECTORS=['Inner Core','Orion Spur','Outer Arm','Perseus Arm','Norma Arm','Sagittarius Arm','Halo Reach'];

/* r128-safe uniform random direction */
function rndDir(){const u=Math.random()*2-1,a=Math.random()*Math.PI*2,s=Math.sqrt(1-u*u);return new THREE.Vector3(s*Math.cos(a),s*Math.sin(a),u);}
/* deterministic per-star pseudo-random */
function h1(i,salt){let x=Math.sin(i*127.1+salt*311.7)*43758.5453;return x-Math.floor(x);}
/* galaxy geometry shared by the scene builder and the star catalogue */
const GALAXY_RMAX=260,GALAXY_TWIST=4.4;
/* Earth (our Sun) on the Orion Spur — the reference point for catalogued distances */
const EARTH_POS=(()=>{const r=150,ang=r/GALAXY_RMAX*GALAXY_TWIST+0.45;return new THREE.Vector3(Math.cos(ang)*r,1.5,Math.sin(ang)*r);})();
/* scene units -> light years, sized so the far rim of the galaxy reads ~7,900 ly */
const LY_PER_UNIT=19.2;
function starInfo(i,pos){
  const id='AST-'+String(100000+(i*7919)%900000);
  const r=h1(i,1);
  const status=r<0.20?'reserved':(r>0.985?'featured':'available');
  const spec=SPECTRAL[Math.floor(h1(i,2)*SPECTRAL.length)];
  const mag=(1.2+h1(i,3)*11).toFixed(2);
  const dist=Math.round(6+pos.distanceTo(EARTH_POS)*LY_PER_UNIT);
  const ang=(Math.atan2(pos.z,pos.x)+Math.PI)/(2*Math.PI);
  const ci=Math.floor(ang*CONSTELLATIONS.length)%CONSTELLATIONS.length;
  const raH=Math.floor(ang*24),raM=Math.floor((ang*24%1)*60),raS=Math.floor((((ang*24%1)*60)%1)*60);
  const dec=(pos.y/120*70).toFixed(0);
  const sec=SECTORS[Math.floor((Math.hypot(pos.x,pos.z)/240)*SECTORS.length)%SECTORS.length];
  return{id,status,spec,mag,dist,ci,sec,
    ra:`${String(raH).padStart(2,'0')}h ${String(raM).padStart(2,'0')}m ${String(raS).padStart(2,'0')}s`,
    dec:`${dec>=0?'+':'−'}${String(Math.abs(dec)).padStart(2,'0')}° ${Math.floor(h1(i,5)*60)}′ ${Math.floor(h1(i,6)*60)}″`};
}

function spriteTexture(inner,outer){
  const c=document.createElement('canvas');c.width=c.height=64;
  const g=c.getContext('2d').createRadialGradient(32,32,0,32,32,32);
  g.addColorStop(0,inner);g.addColorStop(.35,outer);g.addColorStop(1,'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
  const x=c.getContext('2d');x.fillStyle=g;x.fillRect(0,0,64,64);
  const t=new THREE.CanvasTexture(c);return t;
}
function nebulaTexture(hue){
  const c=document.createElement('canvas');c.width=c.height=256;const x=c.getContext('2d');
  for(let i=0;i<26;i++){
    const g=x.createRadialGradient(128+(Math.random()-.5)*150,128+(Math.random()-.5)*150,0,128,128,90+Math.random()*70);
    g.addColorStop(0,`hsla(${hue+Math.random()*30-15},70%,60%,${.05+Math.random()*.06})`);
    g.addColorStop(1,'rgba(0,0,0,0)');x.fillStyle=g;x.fillRect(0,0,256,256);
  }
  /* radial mask so the canvas edge never shows as a square seam */
  x.globalCompositeOperation='destination-in';
  const m=x.createRadialGradient(128,128,40,128,128,126);
  m.addColorStop(0,'rgba(0,0,0,1)');m.addColorStop(.7,'rgba(0,0,0,.6)');m.addColorStop(1,'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
  x.fillStyle=m;x.fillRect(0,0,256,256);
  x.globalCompositeOperation='source-over';
  return new THREE.CanvasTexture(c);
}
function spaceBackdrop(){
  const c=document.createElement('canvas');c.width=1024;c.height=1024;const x=c.getContext('2d');
  const g=x.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,1024);
  g.addColorStop(0,'#010208');g.addColorStop(.4,'#03051a');g.addColorStop(.7,'#060417');g.addColorStop(1,'#010106');
  x.fillStyle=g;x.fillRect(0,0,1024,1024);
  /* diagonal milky-way band of pale light */
  x.save();x.translate(512,512);x.rotate(-.42);
  const band=x.createLinearGradient(0,-190,0,190);
  band.addColorStop(0,'rgba(120,130,200,0)');
  band.addColorStop(.5,'rgba(180,185,235,.04)');
  band.addColorStop(1,'rgba(120,130,200,0)');
  x.fillStyle=band;x.fillRect(-900,-190,1800,380);
  x.restore();
  /* colour-varied nebula haze: violet, magenta, teal, warm gold */
  const hues=[258,290,315,195,225,42];
  for(let i=0;i<22;i++){
    const cx2=Math.random()*1024,cy=Math.random()*1024,r=120+Math.random()*280;
    const h=hues[i%hues.length];
    const gg=x.createRadialGradient(cx2,cy,0,cx2,cy,r);
    gg.addColorStop(0,`hsla(${h},60%,${h===42?60:48}%,${.018+Math.random()*.022})`);
    gg.addColorStop(1,'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
    x.fillStyle=gg;x.fillRect(0,0,1024,1024);
  }
  /* layered star dust: fine grain + a scatter of brighter glowing dots */
  for(let i=0;i<1400;i++){
    x.fillStyle=`rgba(255,255,255,${.08+Math.random()*.45})`;
    x.fillRect(Math.random()*1024,Math.random()*1024,Math.random()<.85?1:2,1);
  }
  for(let i=0;i<60;i++){
    const sx=Math.random()*1024,sy=Math.random()*1024,sr=1.2+Math.random()*1.8;
    const sg=x.createRadialGradient(sx,sy,0,sx,sy,sr*3);
    sg.addColorStop(0,`rgba(255,255,255,${.5+Math.random()*.4})`);
    sg.addColorStop(.4,'rgba(210,220,255,.25)');sg.addColorStop(1,'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
    x.fillStyle=sg;x.beginPath();x.arc(sx,sy,sr*3,0,7);x.fill();
  }
  return new THREE.CanvasTexture(c);
}
function labelSprite(text,color){
  const c=document.createElement('canvas');c.width=512;c.height=96;const x=c.getContext('2d');
  x.font='600 46px Cormorant Garamond, Georgia, serif';x.textAlign='center';x.textBaseline='middle';
  x.letterSpacing='9px';
  /* soft dark backing so labels read over bright star fields */
  x.shadowColor='rgba(0,0,0,.9)';x.shadowBlur=14;
  x.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,.55)';x.fillText(text.toUpperCase(),256,48);
  /* glow pass */
  x.shadowColor=color||'rgba(217,185,108,.9)';x.shadowBlur=18;
  x.fillStyle=color||'rgba(240,215,150,.98)';
  x.fillText(text.toUpperCase(),256,48);
  x.shadowBlur=0;
  x.fillText(text.toUpperCase(),256,48);
  const t=new THREE.CanvasTexture(c);
  const m=new THREE.SpriteMaterial({map:t,transparent:true,opacity:0,depthWrite:false});
  const s=new THREE.Sprite(m);s.scale.set(64,12,1);return s;
}

function buildGalaxy(){
  const E=EXP;
  E.scene=new THREE.Scene();
  E.scene.background=spaceBackdrop();
  E.scene.fog=new THREE.FogExp2(0x02030c,0.0006);
  E.camera=new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(58,innerWidth/innerHeight,0.5,4000);
  E.renderer=new THREE.WebGLRenderer({canvas:$('#gl'),antialias:true,alpha:false});
  E.renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(devicePixelRatio,2));
  E.renderer.setSize(innerWidth,innerHeight);
  E.renderer.setClearColor(0x020409);

  /* --- procedural spiral galaxy --- */
  const N=38000,ARMS=3,RMAX=GALAXY_RMAX,TWIST=GALAXY_TWIST;
  const pos=new Float32Array(N*3),col=new Float32Array(N*3);
  const cWarm=new THREE.Color(0xffe9c4),cBlue=new THREE.Color(0xbcd0ff),cWhite=new THREE.Color(0xf2f2ff),tmp=new THREE.Color();
  for(let i=0;i<N;i++){
    const arm=i%ARMS, t=Math.pow(h1(i,7),0.62), r=t*RMAX;
    const ang=arm*(Math.PI*2/ARMS)+r/RMAX*TWIST+ (h1(i,8)-.5)*(.9-.55*t);
    const x=Math.cos(ang)*r+(h1(i,9)-.5)*14*(1-t*.6);
    const z=Math.sin(ang)*r+(h1(i,10)-.5)*14*(1-t*.6);
    const y=(h1(i,11)-.5)*(20*(1-t)+5);
    pos[i*3]=x;pos[i*3+1]=y;pos[i*3+2]=z;
    const k=h1(i,12);
    tmp.copy(k<.25?cWarm:k<.7?cWhite:cBlue);
    const lum=.7+h1(i,13)*.5;
    col[i*3]=tmp.r*lum;col[i*3+1]=tmp.g*lum;col[i*3+2]=tmp.b*lum;
  }
  E.positions=pos;

  /* split by status into three Points groups */
  const buckets={available:[],reserved:[],featured:[]};
  for(let i=0;i<N;i++){
    const v=new THREE.Vector3(pos[i*3],pos[i*3+1],pos[i*3+2]);
    buckets[starInfo(i,v).status].push(i);
  }
  const texSoft=spriteTexture('rgba(255,255,255,1)','rgba(190,205,255,.55)');
  const texGold=spriteTexture('rgba(255,240,200,1)','rgba(217,185,108,.6)');
  const texFeat=spriteTexture('rgba(255,255,255,1)','rgba(242,220,162,.85)');
  function makePoints(idx,tex,size,useColor){
    const g=new THREE.BufferGeometry();
    const p=new Float32Array(idx.length*3),c=new Float32Array(idx.length*3);
    idx.forEach((gi,j)=>{p[j*3]=pos[gi*3];p[j*3+1]=pos[gi*3+1];p[j*3+2]=pos[gi*3+2];
      c[j*3]=col[gi*3];c[j*3+1]=col[gi*3+1];c[j*3+2]=col[gi*3+2];});
    g.setAttribute('position',new THREE.BufferAttribute(p,3));
    if(useColor)g.setAttribute('color',new THREE.BufferAttribute(c,3));
    const m=new THREE.PointsMaterial({size,map:tex,transparent:true,depthWrite:false,
      blending:THREE.AdditiveBlending,vertexColors:useColor,color:useColor?0xffffff:0xf2dca2,
      sizeAttenuation:true,opacity:.95});
    const pts=new THREE.Points(g,m);E.scene.add(pts);return pts;
  }
  E.groups.available=makePoints(buckets.available,texSoft,2.1,true);
  E.groups.reserved=makePoints(buckets.reserved,texGold,2.5,false);
  E.groups.featured=makePoints(buckets.featured,texFeat,7.5,false);
  E.indexMaps={available:buckets.available,reserved:buckets.reserved,featured:buckets.featured};

  /* detail layer: faint extra stars revealed when zoomed in */
  {
    const M=16000,p=new Float32Array(M*3);
    for(let i=0;i<M;i++){
      const t=Math.pow(h1(i,21),0.6),r=t*RMAX,a=Math.random()*Math.PI*2+r/RMAX*TWIST;
      p[i*3]=Math.cos(a)*r+(Math.random()-.5)*18;p[i*3+1]=(Math.random()-.5)*16*(1-t*.5);p[i*3+2]=Math.sin(a)*r+(Math.random()-.5)*18;
    }
    const g=new THREE.BufferGeometry();g.setAttribute('position',new THREE.BufferAttribute(p,3));
    const m=new THREE.PointsMaterial({size:1.1,map:texSoft,transparent:true,opacity:0,depthWrite:false,blending:THREE.AdditiveBlending,color:0xaebcdc});
    E.detailLayer=new THREE.Points(g,m);E.scene.add(E.detailLayer);
  }

  /* far background shell */
  {
    const M=6000,p=new Float32Array(M*3);
    for(let i=0;i<M;i++){
      const v=rndDir().multiplyScalar(1400+Math.random()*900);
      p[i*3]=v.x;p[i*3+1]=v.y;p[i*3+2]=v.z;
    }
    const g=new THREE.BufferGeometry();g.setAttribute('position',new THREE.BufferAttribute(p,3));
    E.scene.add(new THREE.Points(g,new THREE.PointsMaterial({size:2.4,map:texSoft,transparent:true,opacity:.5,depthWrite:false,blending:THREE.AdditiveBlending,color:0x8fa0d8})));
  }

  /* galactic core + nebulae */
  const core=new THREE.Sprite(new THREE.SpriteMaterial({map:spriteTexture('rgba(255,238,205,1)','rgba(255,200,130,.4)'),transparent:true,opacity:.95,depthWrite:false,blending:THREE.AdditiveBlending}));
  core.scale.set(150,150,1);E.scene.add(core);E.coreSprite=core;
  [[265,60,-30,75],[265+40,-120,90,68],[280,150,60,82]].forEach(([hue,x,z,s],i)=>{
    const n=new THREE.Sprite(new THREE.SpriteMaterial({map:nebulaTexture(hue),transparent:true,opacity:.42,depthWrite:false,blending:THREE.AdditiveBlending}));
    n.scale.set(s*3,s*3,1);n.position.set(x,(i-1)*8,z);E.scene.add(n);
  });

  /* constellation labels (zoom-dependent) */
  CONSTELLATIONS.forEach((c,ci)=>{
    const a=(ci+0.5)/CONSTELLATIONS.length*Math.PI*2-Math.PI;
    const s=labelSprite(c[0]);s.position.set(Math.cos(a)*180,26,Math.sin(a)*180);
    s.scale.set(80,15,1);
    E.labels.push(s);E.scene.add(s);
  });

  /* --- Earth marker: our Sun's place on the Orion Spur --- */
  {
    E.earthPos=EARTH_POS.clone();           /* sits on one of the spiral arms */
    const eTex=spriteTexture('rgba(200,235,255,1)','rgba(100,170,255,.65)');
    E.earthSprite=new THREE.Sprite(new THREE.SpriteMaterial({map:eTex,transparent:true,depthWrite:false,blending:THREE.AdditiveBlending,color:0xaad8ff,opacity:.95}));
    E.earthSprite.position.copy(E.earthPos);E.scene.add(E.earthSprite);
    /* pulsing locator ring in the galactic plane */
    const seg=72,pts=[];
    for(let i=0;i<=seg;i++){const a2=i/seg*Math.PI*2;pts.push(new THREE.Vector3(Math.cos(a2),0,Math.sin(a2)));}
    E.earthRing=new THREE.Line(new THREE.BufferGeometry().setFromPoints(pts),
      new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({color:0x7fc4ff,transparent:true,opacity:.7,blending:THREE.AdditiveBlending}));
    E.earthRing.position.copy(E.earthPos);E.scene.add(E.earthRing);
    E.earthLabel=labelSprite('Earth · You are here','rgba(170,216,255,.95)');
    E.earthLabel.material.opacity=.95;
    E.earthLabel.position.copy(E.earthPos).add(new THREE.Vector3(0,11,0));
    E.scene.add(E.earthLabel);
  }
  E.baseSizes={available:2.1,reserved:2.5,featured:7.5};

  /* warp streaks scene */
  E.warpScene=new THREE.Scene();
  E.warpCam=new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(70,innerWidth/innerHeight,0.1,600);
  const WS=900,wp=new Float32Array(WS*6);
  E.warpData=[];
  for(let i=0;i<WS;i++){
    const a=Math.random()*Math.PI*2,rr=4+Math.random()*60,z=-Math.random()*500;
    E.warpData.push({a,rr,z,sp:2+Math.random()*5});
  }
  const wg=new THREE.BufferGeometry();wg.setAttribute('position',new THREE.BufferAttribute(wp,3));
  E.warpLines=new THREE.LineSegments(wg,new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({color:0xcfd8ff,transparent:true,opacity:.9,blending:THREE.AdditiveBlending}));
  E.warpScene.add(E.warpLines);

  E.nextMeteor=performance.now()+6000;

  E.raycaster=new THREE.Raycaster();
  E.mouse=new THREE.Vector2(-2,-2);
  addEventListener('resize',()=>{
    if(!E.renderer)return;
    E.camera.aspect=innerWidth/innerHeight;E.camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
    E.warpCam.aspect=innerWidth/innerHeight;E.warpCam.updateProjectionMatrix();
    E.renderer.setSize(innerWidth,innerHeight);
  });
  bindControls();
  E.inited=true;
}

/* ---------- camera helpers ---------- */
function camFromSph(){
  const E=EXP,s=E.sph;
  s.phi=Math.max(0.18,Math.min(Math.PI-0.18,s.phi));
  s.r=Math.max(14,Math.min(950,s.r));
  E.camera.position.set(
    E.target.x+s.r*Math.sin(s.phi)*Math.cos(s.theta),
    E.target.y+s.r*Math.cos(s.phi),
    E.target.z+s.r*Math.sin(s.phi)*Math.sin(s.theta));
  E.camera.lookAt(E.target);
}
function startTween(toTarget,toR,dur,after){
  const E=EXP;
  E.tween={t0:performance.now(),dur,after,
    fromT:E.target.clone(),toT:toTarget.clone(),
    fromR:E.sph.r,toR};
}
const easeIO=t=>t<.5?4*t*t*t:1-Math.pow(-2*t+2,3)/2;

/* ---------- controls ---------- */
function bindControls(){
  const E=EXP,cv=$('#gl');let drag=false,pan=false,px=0,py=0,pinch=0;
  const panRight=new THREE.Vector3(),panUp=new THREE.Vector3();
  cv.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{
    if(E.phase!=='explore')return;
    if(e.button===1){e.preventDefault();pan=true;}
    else if(e.button===0)drag=true;
    px=e.clientX;py=e.clientY;cv.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
  });
  /* stop the browser's middle-click autoscroll inside the explorer */
  cv.addEventListener('mousedown',e=>{if(e.button===1)e.preventDefault();});
  cv.addEventListener('pointerup',()=>{drag=false;pan=false;});
  cv.addEventListener('pointermove',e=>{
    E.mouse.x=(e.clientX/innerWidth)*2-1;E.mouse.y=-(e.clientY/innerHeight)*2+1;
    E.tipXY=[e.clientX,e.clientY];
    if((!drag&&!pan)||E.phase!=='explore')return;
    const dx=e.clientX-px,dy=e.clientY-py;px=e.clientX;py=e.clientY;
    if(pan){
      /* middle-mouse pan: slide the orbit target in the camera plane, scaled by zoom */
      const k=E.sph.r*0.0011;
      panRight.setFromMatrixColumn(E.camera.matrixWorld,0);
      panUp.setFromMatrixColumn(E.camera.matrixWorld,1);
      E.target.addScaledVector(panRight,-dx*k).addScaledVector(panUp,dy*k);
      if(E.target.length()>340)E.target.setLength(340);
      return;
    }
    E.vel.t=-dx*0.0042;E.vel.p=-dy*0.0036;
    E.sph.theta+=E.vel.t;E.sph.phi+=E.vel.p;
  });
  cv.addEventListener('wheel',e=>{
    if(E.phase!=='explore')return;e.preventDefault();
    E.sph.r*=Math.pow(1.0016,e.deltaY);
  },{passive:false});
  /* touch pinch */
  cv.addEventListener('touchmove',e=>{
    if(e.touches.length===2&&E.phase==='explore'){
      e.preventDefault();
      const d=Math.hypot(e.touches[0].clientX-e.touches[1].clientX,e.touches[0].clientY-e.touches[1].clientY);
      if(pinch)E.sph.r*=pinch/d;
      pinch=d;
    }
  },{passive:false});
  cv.addEventListener('touchend',()=>pinch=0);
  cv.addEventListener('click',e=>{
    if(E.phase!=='explore'||E.justDragged)return;
    if(E.hover>=0)selectStar(E.hover);
  });
  cv.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{E.downXY=[e.clientX,e.clientY];});
  cv.addEventListener('pointerup',e=>{E.justDragged=Math.hypot(e.clientX-E.downXY[0],e.clientY-E.downXY[1])>6;});
}

/* ---------- hover raycast ---------- */
function doHover(){
  const E=EXP;
  if(E.phase!=='explore'){$('#starTip').classList.remove('on');return;}
  E.raycaster.setFromCamera(E.mouse,E.camera);
  E.raycaster.params.Points.threshold=Math.max(.8,E.sph.r*0.012);
  let best=null,bestKey=null;
  for(const key of['featured','available','reserved']){
    const hit=E.raycaster.intersectObject(E.groups[key],false)[0];
    if(hit&&(!best||hit.distanceToRay<best.distanceToRay)){best=hit;bestKey=key;}
  }
  const tip=$('#starTip');
  if(!best){E.hover=-1;tip.classList.remove('on');$('#gl').style.cursor='grab';return;}
  const gi=E.indexMaps[bestKey][best.index];
  E.hover=(bestKey==='reserved')?-1:gi;
  const v=new THREE.Vector3(E.positions[gi*3],E.positions[gi*3+1],E.positions[gi*3+2]);
  const info=starInfo(gi,v);
  $('#tipName').textContent=info.id;
  $('#tipSpec').textContent=info.spec;$('#tipMag').textContent=info.mag;
  $('#tipDist').textContent=info.dist.toLocaleString()+' ly';
  $('#tipConst').textContent=CONSTELLATIONS[info.ci][0];
  const st=$('#tipStatus');
  st.className='tip-status '+(info.status==='reserved'?'rs':info.status==='featured'?'ft':'av');
  st.textContent=info.status==='reserved'?'Already named':info.status==='featured'?'Featured premium star':'Available to name';
  if(E.tipXY){tip.style.left=Math.min(innerWidth-260,E.tipXY[0])+'px';tip.style.top=Math.min(innerHeight-220,E.tipXY[1])+'px';}
  tip.classList.add('on');
  $('#gl').style.cursor=info.status==='reserved'?'not-allowed':'pointer';
}

/* ---------- selection ---------- */
function selectStar(gi){
  const E=EXP;
  const v=new THREE.Vector3(E.positions[gi*3],E.positions[gi*3+1],E.positions[gi*3+2]);
  const info=starInfo(gi,v);
  state.selectedStar={gi,info,pos:v};
  E.phase='travel';
  $('#starTip').classList.remove('on');
  $('#expHint').style.opacity=0;
  startTween(v,9,2300,()=>{
    E.phase='orbit';
    showDetail(info,v,gi);
    drawConstellation(v,info.ci);
  });
}
function showDetail(info,v,gi){
  $('#d-name').textContent=info.id;
  $('#d-sector').textContent=`Sector ${info.sec} · Astralis catalogue`;
  $('#d-ra').textContent=info.ra;$('#d-dec').textContent=info.dec;
  $('#d-dist').textContent=info.dist.toLocaleString()+' light years';
  $('#d-mag').textContent=info.mag;$('#d-spec').textContent=info.spec;
  $('#d-const').textContent=CONSTELLATIONS[info.ci][0];
  $('#d-myth-name').textContent=CONSTELLATIONS[info.ci][0]+(CONSTELLATIONS[info.ci][2]!=='—'?' · '+CONSTELLATIONS[info.ci][2]:'');
  $('#d-myth-text').textContent=CONSTELLATIONS[info.ci][1];
  /* nearby star ids */
  const near=[];
  for(let k=1;k<=3;k++)near.push('AST-'+String(100000+((gi+k*37)*7919)%900000));
  $('#d-nearby').innerHTML='Nearby stars: <b>'+near.join(' · ')+'</b>';
  $('#detail').classList.add('on');$('#detail').setAttribute('aria-hidden','false');
}
function drawConstellation(center,ci){
  const E=EXP;
  if(E.constLine){E.scene.remove(E.constLine);E.constLine.geometry.dispose();}
  const pts=[center.clone()];let cur=center.clone();
  for(let k=0;k<5;k++){
    cur=cur.clone().add(new THREE.Vector3((h1(ci*9+k,31)-.5)*26,(h1(ci*9+k,32)-.5)*12,(h1(ci*9+k,33)-.5)*26));
    pts.push(cur);
  }
  const g=new THREE.BufferGeometry().setFromPoints(pts);
  g.setDrawRange(0,1);
  E.constLine=new THREE.Line(g,new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({color:0xd9b96c,transparent:true,opacity:.75,blending:THREE.AdditiveBlending}));
  E.scene.add(E.constLine);
  let n=1;const iv=setInterval(()=>{n++;g.setDrawRange(0,n);if(n>=pts.length)clearInterval(iv);},260);
}
function closeDetail(backOut=true){
  const E=EXP;
  $('#detail').classList.remove('on');$('#detail').setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');
  if(E.constLine){E.scene.remove(E.constLine);E.constLine=null;}
  if(backOut){E.phase='travel';startTween(new THREE.Vector3(0,0,0),340,1800,()=>{E.phase='explore';$('#expHint').style.opacity=1;});}
}
$('#detailClose').addEventListener('click',()=>closeDetail());

/* ---------- claim ---------- */
$('#claimBtn').addEventListener('click',()=>{
  const E=EXP,s=state.selectedStar;if(!s)return;
  /* particle burst */
  const M=240,p=new Float32Array(M*3),vels=[];
  for(let i=0;i<M;i++){p[i*3]=s.pos.x;p[i*3+1]=s.pos.y;p[i*3+2]=s.pos.z;
    vels.push(rndDir().multiplyScalar(.12+Math.random()*.4));}
  const g=new THREE.BufferGeometry();g.setAttribute('position',new THREE.BufferAttribute(p,3));
  const m=new THREE.PointsMaterial({size:1.6,map:spriteTexture('rgba(255,245,220,1)','rgba(242,220,162,.7)'),transparent:true,opacity:1,depthWrite:false,blending:THREE.AdditiveBlending,color:0xf2dca2});
  const burst=new THREE.Points(g,m);E.scene.add(burst);
  const t0=performance.now();
  (function anim(){
    const k=(performance.now()-t0)/1300;
    if(k>=1){E.scene.remove(burst);g.dispose();return;}
    const arr=g.attributes.position.array;
    for(let i=0;i<M;i++){arr[i*3]+=vels[i].x;arr[i*3+1]+=vels[i].y;arr[i*3+2]+=vels[i].z;}
    g.attributes.position.needsUpdate=true;m.opacity=1-k;
    requestAnimationFrame(anim);
  })();
  state.reservedStar=s;state.reserveEnds=Date.now()+15*60*1000;
  setTimeout(()=>{
    closeExplorer();
    toast(`Star <b>${s.info.id}</b> in <b>${CONSTELLATIONS[s.info.ci][0]}</b> is reserved for 15 minutes — now choose a package`);
    applyReservation();
    document.getElementById('packages').scrollIntoView({behavior:reduceMotion?'auto':'smooth'});
  },900);
});
function applyReservation(){
  const s=state.reservedStar;if(!s)return;
  $('#reserveBar').classList.add('on');
  $('#rb-id').textContent=s.info.id;
  lc.ra.textContent=s.info.ra;lc.dec.textContent=s.info.dec;
  lc.cons.textContent=CONSTELLATIONS[s.info.ci][0];
  lc.mag.textContent=s.info.mag;lc.cls.textContent=s.info.spec;
  lc.sec.textContent=s.info.sec;lc.id.textContent=s.info.id;
  $('#cs-id').textContent=s.info.id;
  $('#cs-const').textContent=CONSTELLATIONS[s.info.ci][0];
}
setInterval(()=>{
  if(!state.reservedStar)return;
  const d=Math.max(0,state.reserveEnds-Date.now())/1000;
  $('#rb-timer').textContent=`${Math.floor(d/60)}:${String(Math.floor(d)%60).padStart(2,'0')}`;
},1000);

/* ---------- explorer open/close + warp ---------- */
function openExplorer(){
  const ex=$('#explorer');
  ex.classList.add('open');
  requestAnimationFrame(()=>ex.classList.add('visible'));
  document.body.style.overflow='hidden';
  if(!EXP.inited)buildGalaxy();
  const E=EXP;
  $('#detail').classList.remove('on');
  E.target.set(0,0,0);E.sph={r:reduceMotion?340:900,theta:.6,phi:1.15};
  if(reduceMotion){E.phase='explore';}
  else{
    E.phase='warp';E.warpT0=performance.now();
    const wt=$('#warpText');wt.hidden=false;
    wt.innerHTML='<div>Entering Astralis…</div>';
  }
  if(!E.raf)loop();
}
function closeExplorer(){
  const ex=$('#explorer');
  ex.classList.remove('visible');
  setTimeout(()=>{ex.classList.remove('open');},800);
  document.body.style.overflow='';
  cancelAnimationFrame(EXP.raf);EXP.raf=null;EXP.phase='idle';
  if(EXP.audio){EXP.audio.gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0,EXP.audio.ctx.currentTime+.6);}
}
$('#expClose').addEventListener('click',()=>closeExplorer());

/* ---------- ambience (generated, opt-in) ---------- */
$('#soundBtn').addEventListener('click',function(){
  const E=EXP;
  if(!E.audio){
    const ctx=new(window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)();
    const gain=ctx.createGain();gain.gain.value=0;gain.connect(ctx.destination);
    [55,82.4,110,164.8].forEach((f,i)=>{
      const o=ctx.createOscillator();o.type=i%2?'sine':'triangle';o.frequency.value=f;
      const g=ctx.createGain();g.gain.value=.028/(i+1);
      const lfo=ctx.createOscillator();lfo.frequency.value=.05+i*.03;
      const lg=ctx.createGain();lg.gain.value=.01;lfo.connect(lg);lg.connect(g.gain);
      o.connect(g);g.connect(gain);o.start();lfo.start();
    });
    E.audio={ctx,gain,on:false};
  }
  E.audio.on=!E.audio.on;
  E.audio.ctx.resume();
  E.audio.gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(E.audio.on?1:0,E.audio.ctx.currentTime+1.2);
  this.textContent=E.audio.on?'♪ Ambience on':'♪ Ambience off';
  this.setAttribute('aria-pressed',E.audio.on);
});

/* ---------- 3D shooting stars ---------- */
/* Scene-space meteors: real objects in the galaxy, so panning, rotating
   and zooming the camera moves them like everything else. */
function spawnMeteor(){
  const E=EXP;
  const start=rndDir().multiplyScalar(360+Math.random()*160);
  const aim=new THREE.Vector3((Math.random()-.5)*260,(Math.random()-.5)*100,(Math.random()-.5)*260);
  const vel=aim.sub(start).normalize().multiplyScalar(2.4+Math.random()*2.2);
  const g=new THREE.BufferGeometry();
  g.setAttribute('position',new THREE.BufferAttribute(new Float32Array(6),3));
  const mat=new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({color:0xe8eeff,transparent:true,opacity:0,depthWrite:false,blending:THREE.AdditiveBlending});
  const line=new THREE.Line(g,mat);
  E.scene.add(line);
  E.meteors.push({line,mat,pos:start,vel,t0:performance.now(),dur:2600+Math.random()*1800,len:7+Math.random()*6});
}
function updateMeteors(now){
  const E=EXP;
  for(let i=E.meteors.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    const m=E.meteors[i],k=(now-m.t0)/m.dur;
    if(k>=1){E.scene.remove(m.line);m.line.geometry.dispose();m.mat.dispose();E.meteors.splice(i,1);continue;}
    m.pos.add(m.vel);
    const arr=m.line.geometry.attributes.position.array;
    arr[0]=m.pos.x;arr[1]=m.pos.y;arr[2]=m.pos.z;
    arr[3]=m.pos.x-m.vel.x*m.len;arr[4]=m.pos.y-m.vel.y*m.len;arr[5]=m.pos.z-m.vel.z*m.len;
    m.line.geometry.attributes.position.needsUpdate=true;
    /* fade in fast, fade out toward the end of the pass */
    m.mat.opacity=Math.min(1,k*8)*(1-k)*.9;
  }
}

/* ---------- render loop ---------- */
function loop(){
  const E=EXP;
  E.raf=requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  const now=performance.now();

  if(E.phase==='warp'){
    const k=(now-E.warpT0)/2600;
    const arr=E.warpLines.geometry.attributes.position.array;
    const speed=Math.pow(Math.min(1,k),1.6)*36+2;
    E.warpData.forEach((d,i)=>{
      d.z+=d.sp*speed;
      if(d.z>20)d.z=-500-Math.random()*100;
      const x=Math.cos(d.a)*d.rr,y=Math.sin(d.a)*d.rr;
      const stretch=2+speed*1.6;
      arr[i*6]=x;arr[i*6+1]=y;arr[i*6+2]=d.z;
      arr[i*6+3]=x;arr[i*6+4]=y;arr[i*6+5]=d.z-stretch;
    });
    E.warpLines.geometry.attributes.position.needsUpdate=true;
    E.warpCam.position.set(0,0,10);
    E.renderer.render(E.warpScene,E.warpCam);
    if(k>=1){
      E.phase='arrive';$('#warpText').hidden=true;
      startTween(new THREE.Vector3(0,0,0),340,2600,()=>{E.phase='explore';});
    }
    return;
  }

  /* tweens */
  if(E.tween){
    const tw=E.tween,k=Math.min(1,(now-tw.t0)/tw.dur),e=easeIO(k);
    E.target.lerpVectors(tw.fromT,tw.toT,e);
    E.sph.r=tw.fromR+(tw.toR-tw.fromR)*e;
    if(k>=1){const after=tw.after;E.tween=null;after&&after();}
  }
  /* inertia + slow auto-rotate */
  if(E.phase==='explore'){
    E.sph.theta+=E.vel.t;E.sph.phi+=E.vel.p;
    E.vel.t*=.94;E.vel.p*=.94;
    E.sph.theta+=0.00035;
  }
  if(E.phase==='orbit'){E.sph.theta+=0.0035;}
  camFromSph();

  /* progressive richness with zoom + brightness control when zoomed in */
  const z=E.sph.r;
  const fade=THREE.MathUtils.clamp((z-14)/150,0.62,1);     /* dims gently, stars stay solid */
  const sizeFade=THREE.MathUtils.clamp((z-14)/170,0.35,1); /* shrink points harder than opacity */
  ['available','reserved','featured'].forEach(k=>{
    const m=E.groups[k].material;
    m.opacity=.95*fade;
    m.size=E.baseSizes[k]*(0.35+0.65*sizeFade);
  });
  if(E.coreSprite)E.coreSprite.material.opacity=THREE.MathUtils.clamp((z-30)/220,0.1,0.95);
  if(E.detailLayer)E.detailLayer.material.opacity=THREE.MathUtils.clamp((220-z)/180,0,0.4);
  const lop=THREE.MathUtils.clamp((650-z)/240,0,1)*THREE.MathUtils.clamp((z-34)/55,0,1);
  E.labels.forEach(l=>l.material.opacity=lop);
  /* Earth marker keeps a readable, gently pulsing presence at every zoom */
  if(E.earthSprite){
    const pulse=1+Math.sin(now*0.004)*.18;
    const es=Math.max(3.4,z*0.022)*pulse;
    E.earthSprite.scale.set(es,es,1);
    const rs=(Math.max(4,z*0.03))*(1+Math.sin(now*0.003)*.22);
    E.earthRing.scale.set(rs,rs,rs);
    E.earthRing.material.opacity=.35+.35*Math.abs(Math.sin(now*0.003));
    const ls=Math.max(18,Math.min(70,z*0.17));
    E.earthLabel.scale.set(ls,ls*0.1875,1);
    E.earthLabel.position.set(E.earthPos.x,E.earthPos.y+Math.max(5,z*0.035),E.earthPos.z);
  }

  /* occasional shooting stars crossing the galaxy */
  if(!reduceMotion){
    if(now>=E.nextMeteor){spawnMeteor();E.nextMeteor=now+5000+Math.random()*9000;}
    updateMeteors(now);
  }

  if(E.phase==='explore')doHover();
  E.renderer.render(E.scene,E.camera);
}
